t: You're on South Audley Street, a major shopping street in Mayfair. It runs from the southwest corner of Grosvenor Square down to Curzon Street. People have lived and died along it. Charlotte Knollys died here; she was Lady of the Bedchamber, and the first woman private secretary, to Princess Alexandra of Denmark, later Queen Alexandra, consort of Edward the Seventh. Gertrude Smyth, Lady Dinorden, also died on this street. And Bina Shivdasani once lived here. It's a busy, smart stretch now, with a quiet layer of history behind the shopfronts.
